The web version of cropmark includes the following third-party software. Each keeps
its own license.

DejaVu Sans 2.37 (the font used for text and for the editor's labels)
  Copyright (c) 2003 Bitstream, Inc.; DejaVu changes are in the public domain
  Bitstream Vera license (full text below)
  File: third_party/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf

stb_image, stb_image_write, stb_truetype (image decoding and encoding, font rendering)
  by Sean Barrett and contributors; public domain / MIT
  Files: core/third_party/ (part of the core repository)

SDL 2 (window, input and drawing), compiled in by Emscripten
  Copyright (C) 1997-2022 Sam Lantinga; zlib license
  https://www.libsdl.org

Emscripten runtime (the JavaScript that loads the WebAssembly module)
  Copyright (c) Emscripten authors; MIT / University of Illinois-NCSA
  https://emscripten.org

cropmark itself is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 (see LICENSE).
